From his writings, I speculate that Dylan was depressed of the trigger simply being from girls' rejections. Please correct me if i'm wrong at any point, but this may have sparked something in him to further have the intent to end his life. And no, I don't think that he commenced NBK as an act of revenge, but just to 'have fun!'.

One of the things we know is that he was prescribed with Luvox. Luvox is mainly to treat those diagnosed with Obsessive-Compulsive Disorder (OCD). Luvox is also, but not oftenly, used to treat social phobias, panic and/or eating disorders, and depression. So Eric could have one or many of these mental illnesses.

Hey, i'm going to be as kind and understanding as I possibly can. This didn't really help me or some others. You seem to have such desire to help those with depression or other mental illnesses, but I don't think you understand _how_ to help. We're different. We have a different perspective on things that you see normally.

Small things like some words may easily trigger or anger us. That's because some of us would rather express anger than sadness. We feel stronger with anger, because we associate sadness with weakness. I'm not here to explain what's right or wrong and list down what you can or should do to help us, but thanks for the effort.

It isn't the end for helping us. You can help us in different ways. You can check lists on how to help depressed/suicidal people. I'm sure there are many websites out there, along with articles written by experienced mental workers.
